runs.content: Incyte (NASDAQ, $123.20) was bought as the day's momentum pick. It sits ~5% below its 52-week high above a rising 200-day average, raised FY26 net-sales guidance to $5.13–5.26B in July, and trades at ~11x EV/EBIT with $4.5B cash, a Burry-aligned healthcare name. OXY was exited as a capacity trim (−7.04%, −$70) to hold the book at 35 positions, which also trims energy concentration. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.44 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,423 (+2.06% on $69,000).

Shell plc (LSE, 3,657p) was bought as the day's energy sector-rotation pick. Renewed US–Iran tensions lifted oil and made energy one of only a few gaining sectors in a −0.8% S&P session with the 10Y yield at 5.24%. Shell closed at a 52-week high yet trades ~9x forward earnings, has a buyback running to 23 Oct, and diversifies the book beyond CVX/COP/OXY. NOC was exited as a capacity trim (−7.70%, −$77) to hold the book at 35 positions. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $0.97 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,554 (+2.29% on $68,000).
